On September 25, 2025, James Comey was indicted by a federal grand jury in Virginia on two counts—making a false statement to Congress and obstructing a congressional proceeding—related to his September 30, 2020, Senate testimony; he pleaded not guilty and a trial was scheduled for January 2026 [d81184533s0p0].
